ALTER TABLE leads
  ADD COLUMN instagram VARCHAR(100) AFTER city,
  ADD COLUMN funnel_step ENUM('visualizou_pacote','preencheu_dados','escolheu_datas','iniciou_pagamento','pagou','agendou_call') AFTER last_contact,
  ADD COLUMN funnel_package VARCHAR(100) AFTER funnel_step,
  ADD COLUMN funnel_package_type VARCHAR(50) AFTER funnel_package,
  ADD COLUMN funnel_package_price INT AFTER funnel_package_type,
  ADD COLUMN funnel_preferred_dates TEXT AFTER funnel_package_price,
  ADD COLUMN funnel_period VARCHAR(50) AFTER funnel_preferred_dates,
  ADD COLUMN funnel_expectations TEXT AFTER funnel_period,
  ADD COLUMN funnel_stripe_pi VARCHAR(100) AFTER funnel_expectations,
  ADD COLUMN funnel_paid_at TIMESTAMP NULL AFTER funnel_stripe_pi,
  ADD COLUMN funnel_call_scheduled_at TIMESTAMP NULL AFTER funnel_paid_at,
  ADD COLUMN funnel_last_event_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AFTER funnel_call_scheduled_at;
